item.title: Antifa activist who urged armed resistance to ICE seeks Supreme Court release
item.description: A self-described antifa agitator who called for confronting ICE officers with weapons asked the Supreme Court on Friday to order his release.

item.description: Conservatives have yet to build the institutions, infrastructure, and legal capacity needed to counter lawfare before it harms more people.

item.title: AI industry is playing God in the strangest way
item.description: Several AI company executives have become convinced they are creating a new form of sentience.

item.title: Kennedy Center Honors to be held at Capital One Arena amid Trump name dispute
item.description: This year's Kennedy Center Honors will take place at Washington's Capital One Arena, not the riverfront building at the center of a legal dispute.
